test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 31 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct meaning of the given idiom/phrase from the options:
"In the same boat"
solution: The correct answer is: **1) Facing the same situation**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"In the same boat"** means being in the same difficult or unpleasant situation as someone else. (एक ही जैसी स्थिति का सामना करना) • **Example:** During the lockdown, many small businesses were in the same boat, struggling to survive. • This idiom is used to emphasize shared challenges or problems that people are experiencing together. (यह मुहावरा एक जैसी समस्याओं या चुनौतियों का सामूहिक रूप से सामना करने का संकेत देता है।) Therefore, the correct answer is: **1) Facing the same situation**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Being very wealthy** (बहुत अमीर होना): Refers to someone who has a lot of money or riches. • **Example:** The businessman is being very wealthy after his company’s success. • **Traveling together** (साथ यात्रा करना): Refers to a group of people moving from one place to another together. • **Example:** We are traveling together to the mountains for our vacation. • **Owning a boat** (नाव का मालिक होना): Refers to the possession of a boat by a person. • **Example:** He is owning a boat for fishing purposes. c9:T96c, The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. To attempt something without the necessary resources**.
